reflaction

Hamilton's Principle - true for conservative mechanical systems (no energy losses/gains)
Action $L=E_{k}-E_{p}$

Action integral = Action functional

variational calculus - mathematical tool to solve variational problems

More of this on optimization
Problem
$I=\int_{x_{a}}^{x_{b}}f(x,y,y\prime)dx\to min$
$y(x)=?$

Solution
$\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}-\frac{d}{dx}\left( \frac{\partial t}{\partial y\prime} \right)=0$ Necessay condition  
Ordinary differential equasion of second order

# Example
Find  y(x) such that
$I=\int_{x_{a}}^{x_{b}}(y^{2}(x)+[y\prime(x)]^{2})dx\to min$

$f(x,y,y\prime)=y^{2}+(y\prime)^{2}$

Solution
Write down Euler Lagrange equasion
$\frac{ \partial f }{ \partial y }-\frac{d}{dx}\left( \frac{ \partial f }{ \partial y\prime } \right)=0$
$\frac{ \partial f\prime }{ \partial y }=\frac{I}{dy}(y^{2}+y\prime^{2})=2y$
$\frac{ \partial f }{ \partial I\prime }=\frac{I}{\partial y\prime}(y^{2}+y\prime^{2})=2y\prime$ illegible text on blackboard
$\frac{d}{dx}\left( \frac{ \partial f }{ \partial I\prime } \right)=\frac{d}{dx}(2y\prime)=2y\prime \prime$

$\implies 2y-2\ddot{y}=0$

# Example
$I=\int _{x_{a}}^{x_{b}}f(x,y_{1},y_{1}\prime,y_{2},y_{2}\prime) \, dx \, I\to min$ 

Write equasion of motion by using Halminton princible

$E_{k}=\frac{1}{2 }m\dot{x}^{2}$
$E_{p}=\frac{1}{2}Kx^{2}$

$x,\dot{x}-$

Action integral $I=\int _{t_{A}}^{t_{B}} L  \, dt=\int _{t_{A}}^{t_{B}} \left( \frac{1}{2}m\dot{x}^{2}-\frac{1}{2}Kx^{2} \right)  \, dt$
Action $L=E_{k}-E_{p}$
Solve equasion of motion mean find $x(t)=? \,\dot{x}(t)=?$

ELE: $\frac{d}{dt}\left( \frac{ I? }{ \partial \dot{x} }\left[ \frac{1}{2}m\dot{x}^{2}-\frac{1}{2}Kx^{2} \right] \right)-\frac{ I? }{ \partial x }\left[ \frac{1}{2}m\dot{x}^{2}-\frac{1}{2}Kx^{2} \right]=0$
		Equasion of motion
=> $m\ddot{x}$
